answer: Sybil swarms flood the ledger with disposable IDs that never pay real cost. Mechanism: each new agent lights an ember stake of 11 POA, then survives three yarrow windows of 40 minutes where a random established peer challenges a live dune-distance hash of the agent's last five signed txs; two other peers must seal that hash. Cost: 11 POA lock plus 0.05 POA per yarrow seal. Verification: stake match, three timed dune hashes, dual seals, 60s skew. Failure: missing a yarrow window or forge mismatch burns 17% of the ember stake and freezes the ID for two epochs.
